Generate Python code based on the following instruction. Output ONLY code. DO NOT include explanations or other textual content.
Instruction: Generate code that performs a multiphysics analysis using the PyAEDT library. The code should import the necessary libraries and set the graphical mode. It should then download and open a project, and start HFSS with a specified version. The code should also start a Circuit and add the HFSS dynamic link component to it. It should set up dynamic link options and create ports and excitations. The code should then create a setup and solve the circuit, pushing excitations to the HFSS model. It should start Mechanical and copy bodies from the HFSS project. The code should get losses from HFSS and assign the convection to Mechanical. Finally, the code should plot the model, solve and plot the thermal results, and release AEDT.

```python
import os
import urllib.request
from pyaedt import Desktop, Hfss, Circuit, Mechanical
from pyaedt import downloads

# Set graphical mode
desktop_version = "2023.2"
non_graphical = False

# Download example project
project_url = "https://github.com/pyansys/PyAEDT-Examples/raw/main/Examples/Multiphysics/Multiphysics_Example.aedt"
project_name = "Multiphysics_Example.aedt"
if not os.path.exists(project_name):
    urllib.request.urlretrieve(project_url, project_name)

# Launch AEDT Desktop
d = Desktop(desktop_version, non_graphical=non_graphical, new_desktop_session=True)

# Open project and start HFSS
hfss = Hfss(projectname=project_name, specified_version=desktop_version, designname="HFSSDesign1", solution_type="DrivenModal")

# Start Circuit and add HFSS dynamic link component
circuit = Circuit(projectname=project_name, specified_version=desktop_version, designname="CircuitDesign1")
hfss_comp = circuit.modeler.schematic.add_dynamic_link(hfss, setup_name="Setup1", sweep_name="LastAdaptive")

# Set up dynamic link options
hfss_comp.parameters["UsePortImpedance"] = True
hfss_comp.parameters["PreserveTerminalNames"] = True

# Create ports and excitations
port1 = circuit.modeler.schematic.create_port("Port1", pos_x=0, pos_y=0)
port2 = circuit.modeler.schematic.create_port("Port2", pos_x=2, pos_y=0)
circuit.modeler.schematic.connect_components(port1.id, hfss_comp.id, 0, 0)
circuit.modeler.schematic.connect_components(hfss_comp.id, port2.id, 1, 0)

# Create setup and solve the circuit, push excitations to HFSS
setup_circuit = circuit.create_setup("Setup1")
setup_circuit.props["Frequency"] = "5GHz"
circuit.analyze_setup("Setup1")
circuit.push_excitation_to_hfss(hfss, "Setup1")

# Start Mechanical and copy bodies from HFSS
mechanical = Mechanical(projectname=project_name, specified_version=desktop_version, designname="MechanicalDesign1")
mechanical.copy_solid_bodies_from(hfss)

# Get losses from HFSS and assign convection to Mechanical
losses = hfss.post.get_loss("Setup1")
for body, loss in losses.items():
    mechanical.assign_surface_heat_flux(body, loss)
    mechanical.assign_convection(body, convection_value=10, ambient_temperature=22)

# Plot the model
mechanical.plot(show=True)

# Solve and plot the thermal results
mechanical.analyze_setup("Setup1")
mechanical.plot_contour(plot_type="Temperature", show=True)

# Release AEDT
d.release_desktop(close_projects=True, close_desktop=True)
```
